title: Busan court jails 70s shaman-monk for raping disciple under exorcism pretext
excerpt: Busan court jails 70s shaman-monk for raping disciple under exorcism pretext
content:
A shaman in his 70s who is also a monk was sentenced to five years in prison for repeatedly raping a disciple, saying an exorcism ritual was needed.

The Busan District Court Dongbu Branch Criminal Division 1 (Chief Judge Lee Dong-gi) said on the 26th that it sentenced a defendant identified as A to five years in prison on charges including rape, quasi-rape, and intercourse with a person under protection, ordered completion of 80 hours of sex offender treatment, and imposed a five-year employment restriction.

A was indicted on charges of threatening a shamanic disciple in her 30s identified as B in or around January 2024 in places such as a car and a hotel by saying, "The soul of your dead master is in your body and an exorcism is necessary," and raping her.

A also was found to have said, "If you do not have sexual relations, you will end up committing suicide, bad things will happen to your family, and you will be struck dumb." When B refused the demands, A conducted a ritual using a weapon and repeatedly stressed the need for sexual relations.

A denied some of the charges, saying the relations were consensual. But the court said, "B's statements are consistent and specific in key parts and align with the related evidence," and rejected A's claims.

The court particularly found that A committed the crimes by exploiting A's position as B's shamanic master and B's reliance on shamanic beliefs.

The court said, "It cannot be deemed that the victim consented to sexual relations merely because the victim complied with the defendant's demands or could not explicitly resist."

The court added, "The crimes were committed multiple times by exploiting the victim's religious and psychological vulnerability, and the victim appears to have suffered significant mental anguish," and said, "There has been no remorse and no restitution to the victim," in explaining the sentence.
